shapes.name: ScriptSheetBody
shapes.doc: A Script Sheet is the small writing setup: one instruction instead of a preset's block list. The card, persona, lore, memory and history are seated around it automatically (core/preset/script-sheet.ts), so a scene can use it where it would use a preset. Samplers are the preset's own kind, so a sheet becomes a preset with nothing lost.

fields.name: content
fields.meaning: The instruction. Context macros are refused where it is written and when it is sent, never when it is read.
